Class MightOwnMemoryAddressContainer

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Internal
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a memory address container that may own the memory it points to. It has a destructor that lets it decide which one it is. This is for single ownership.

public class MightOwnMemoryAddressContainer : IDisposable
